title: Chananiah bar Idi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 105a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.105a): Rav Shmuel bar Idi sent to them, “Chananiah my brother says one” (and the halakhah does not follow him). Were I not afraid, I would say that it should read that Rav Shmuel bar Idi sent: “Chananiah [son of] the brother of [R' Yehoshua] says one.” And, as they said there at the end of the page, it was taught in the name of ריב״ח—and the halakhah does not follow him. The matter requires further study.[^1]

notes.text: The brackets [son of] and [R' Yehoshua] are Hyman’s suggested additions. The concluding personal abbreviation ריב״ח is left unexpanded.
